description: QFN-24(4x4) Power Distribution Switches, Load Drivers

parameters.Features: Overcurrent Protection;Short-Circuit  Protection;Under-voltage lockout;Thermal Protection;Overload protection

notes: NOT the genuine TI part - Tokmas' pin-compatible clone of the TPS26630.
Integrated 40 V hot-swap FET. That is 1.43x margin on a 28 V bus but only 1.11x at 36 V, which is too thin for a bus feeding inductive cable runs. Rejected when the design moved to 36 V.
Would have been a good choice at 28 V: adjustable 0.6-5 A limit that holds in constant-current mode rather than merely tripping, dVdT inrush slew, OVP, reverse blocking in 0.2 us, IMON and PGOOD.
Its job is instead done by the p.16 Figure 6 P-FET with an RC gate network - see the design README. The topology 36 V forces on us already contains inrush control.

OBSOLETE CONTEXT: this record says the eFuse job 'is instead done by the p.16 Figure 6 P-FET with an RC gate network'. There is no P-FET and no RC gate network. Per-channel current limiting, power limiting and overvoltage lockout are done by two LM5069 hot-swap controllers (C52940995).
